cache-descriptions.core-cache-pipelines: Caches compiled XPL pipelines, XSLT stylesheets, and parsed XML configuration files in memory so Orbeon Forms does not have to re-parse them on every request. Entries are automatically invalidated whenever an underlying resource changes, and clearing this cache is safe.
cache-descriptions.core-cache-properties: Caches parsed configuration property sets (from XML files and the Configuration UI) along with their change tags so property lookups stay fast on every request. Clearing this cache is safe and forces a fresh reload from property providers on the next request.
cache-descriptions.core-cache-xpath: Caches compiled XPath expressions used by formulas, validations, visibility rules, and actions across all forms. Evicting or clearing entries is safe — expressions are recompiled automatically the next time they are evaluated.
cache-descriptions.fr-cache-form-metadata: Caches published form metadata queried from the database (such as latest version numbers, permissions, indexed fields, and encrypted fields) for a short time to reduce database traffic. Publishing a form invalidates its entry automatically, and clearing this cache is safe.
cache-descriptions.fr-store-external-modes: Temporarily stores encrypted form state tokens when transitioning between Form Runner and external workflows (such as external review, PDF, or callback pages). Entries expire automatically after a short time.
cache-descriptions.xforms-cache-live-documents: Keeps recently used open form instances ready in JVM memory for fast interactive updates. When this cache reaches its entry or memory limit, the least recently used open forms are passivated to xforms.store.dynamic-states rather than lost, and rehydrate automatically when the user interacts with them again.
cache-descriptions.xforms-cache-shared-instances: Shares read-only XML data instances (such as localized form resources and static lookup lists) across all users viewing the same form so each open form does not keep its own copy in memory. Clearing this cache is safe — shared data is reloaded on demand.
cache-descriptions.xforms-cache-static-states: Holds the analyzed structure, formulas, and HTML template of each loaded form in JVM memory, shared by all users opening that form. If an entry is evicted or cleared, Orbeon Forms restores it automatically from xforms.store.static-states (or recompiles the form if needed).
cache-descriptions.xforms-cache-xbl-bindings: Holds the shared definitions of built-in and custom UI controls (such as date pickers, dropdowns, grids, and section templates) loaded once for the entire server. Because all forms share this single library in memory, it stays resident for the lifetime of the server.
cache-descriptions.xforms-store-asset-bundles: Maps hashed JavaScript and CSS bundle URLs to the list of scripts and stylesheets needed by each page, overflowing older mappings to disk when needed so browsers can reliably load combined page assets.
cache-descriptions.xforms-store-dynamic-states: Stores the initial and passivated data of open user forms (in memory and overflowed to disk) so users never lose their work when a form leaves xforms.cache.live-documents or when navigating back in the browser. Entries are cleaned up automatically when user sessions end or expire.
cache-descriptions.xforms-store-static-states: Stores compact, compressed snapshots of compiled forms (with disk overflow) behind xforms.cache.static-states. When a large form leaves the in-memory static state cache, it is restored quickly from this store without recompiling from scratch.
